working: Going from proximal to distal in the human lower limb: the femur (thigh) comes first. The patella (kneecap) lies at the knee joint, in front of the femur–tibia articulation. Below the knee is the tibia (with the fibula), followed by the tarsals of the ankle, then metatarsals and phalanges. This gives the order femur → patella → tibia → tarsal, which matches option 3.
